enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn onto side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Turn onto other side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn again. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms. Yawn. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Walk to door.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Remove toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open closet. Take out clothes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pack bag. Pick up phone. Turn off light. Exit bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Clock in. Put on ID badge. Attend morning briefing. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Assist with procedure. Consult with doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Check emails. Attend afternoon meeting. Update records. Clock out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Wash dishes. Turn off light.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Open laptop. Turn on TV. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Watch TV. Scroll. Click. Type. Watch TV. Stand up. Take out drink. Sit down. Drink. Type. Watch TV. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Turn to other side. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Snore lightly. Turn again. Remain still.
